multimodal_understanding_generation.name: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct
multimodal_understanding_generation.summary: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct 是一个轻量级的 20 亿参数视觉语言模型，能够同时理解图像和文本，实现多模态对话与推理。其技术核心在于高效的跨模态融合架构，在保持较强推理能力的同时，模型尺寸足够小，适合在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。开发者可通过 Hugging Face Transformers 直接调用该模型，应用于视觉问答、图像描述生成，或构建能够结合视觉内容与文本输入的交互式 AI 助手，为实际场景提供灵活的多模态解决方案。
multimodal_understanding_generation.summary_en: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct is a lightweight 2-billion-parameter vision-language model that enables conversational AI to understand and reason about both images and text simultaneously. Its technical innovation lies in efficient multimodal fusion architecture that maintains strong reasoning capabilities while being small enough for edge deployment. Developers can use it through Hugging Face Transformers for applications like visual question answering, image captioning, or building interactive AI assistants that process visual content alongside text inputs.

vector_retrieval.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L12-v2
vector_retrieval.summary: 这是一个基于MiniLM架构的交叉编码器模型，用于搜索结果重排序。它将查询与文档拼接后共同编码，输出单一相关性分数，实现深层语义匹配。模型在MS MARCO数据集上微调，兼顾速度与准确性。可集成到两阶段检索流程：先用双编码器快速召回候选文档，再由此模型精确重排。适用于搜索引擎、问答系统等需要精准文本排序的场景，提升结果相关性。
vector_retrieval.summary_en: This cross-encoder model re-ranks search results by scoring query-document relevance, improving accuracy over initial retrievers. It uses a BERT-based MiniLM architecture fine-tuned on MS MARCO, balancing speed and precision. Technically, it jointly encodes query and document into a single relevance score, enabling deeper semantic matching. You can integrate it into a two-stage retrieval pipeline: first retrieve candidates via bi-encoders, then re-rank with this model. Ideal for search engines, QA systems, or any application needing precise text ranking.

vector_retrieval.name: finance-embeddings-investopedia
vector_retrieval.summary: Finance-Embeddings-Investopedia是一个基于Investopedia金融术语表微调的句子嵌入模型，专为金融文本生成高质量向量表示。其核心优势在于领域特定训练，能够准确捕捉金融术语的语义相似性，适用于金融文档聚类、问答系统或构建金融搜索引擎。该模型支持Hugging Face的text-embeddings-inference推理框架，可部署在Azure上。通过该模型，开发者可以快速将金融文本转化为语义向量，提升金融NLP任务的准确性。
vector_retrieval.summary_en: Finance-Embeddings-Investopedia is a sentence-transformer model fine-tuned on Investopedia's financial glossary, designed to generate high-quality embeddings for financial text. Its key strength lies in domain-specific training, enabling accurate semantic similarity and retrieval for finance-related queries. Use it for tasks like financial document clustering, question answering, or building a finance-specific search engine. The model is compatible with Hugging Face's text-embeddings-inference and can be deployed on Azure.

summary_short.zh: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 是一个高效的句子嵌入模型，能将文本转换为有意义的向量表示，用于计算语义相似度。它通过知识蒸馏技术从大型模型中学习，仅用2270万参数就实现了接近大模型的性能，特别适合资源受限环境。开发者可通过Hugging Face快速调用该模型，应用于智能搜索、文档聚类或内容推荐等场景，探索语义理解在实际项目中的潜力。

multilingual_processing.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
multilingual_processing.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
multilingual_processing.summary_en: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 is a compact multilingual sentence encoder that solves the challenge of understanding semantic similarity across 50+ languages without language-specific models.
